final_text:
Fixed. The bug was at `inventory_service/orders.py:105` — the refund tax was computed on the line net **before** subtracting the refund's share of order-level (tier/coupon) discounts, instead of on the discounted taxable amount. That's why only discounted orders were affected.

One-line fix: `percent_of(net, rate)` → `percent_of(taxable, rate)`.

Ticket scenario now refunds 73.84 + 73.84 = 147.68 (order total), and all 30 tests pass.
